text:
Elena Park: HarborPrime reserved pool go-live tomorrow 08:00 PT. Need final decisions on steady vs burst carve, autoscale profile, and whether to soft-throttle heavy analytics endpoints. @Noah Grant?
Noah Grant: Their commit is 62k tokens/min. I propose 46.5k baseline (75%) + 15.5k burst for the first 72h. Include KV prefix priming 15m pre-run.
Samira (CSM): Confirmed with customer  they accept a 25% buffer for 72h if Finance tags it as "bring-up buffer" and not bill overage. They want a 10-min morning check and a short enablement after the first run.
Noah Grant: Plan: (1) 15m prefix priming, (2) 12m steady at 46.5k, (3) 2m controlled spike to 64k. Autoscale: scale-up window=30s, warmup cooldown=60s. If p95 > 300ms for >90s, enable fallback routing for 5% traffic to quantized-variant.
Elena Park: Agree. Also add a soft-throttle rule for /batch/analytics and /ingest during spikes; keep admin routes unthrottled.
Noah Grant: k6 spike snippet: ```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rw-dedicated-13b', prompt:'warmup'}), { headers: { 'Authorization':'Bearer $TEST' } });
}
```
test-bot: Load test queued by Noah Grant: job_id=hp-warm-501, start=2025-02-12T02:15:00Z, runner=k6-3.4
test-bot: Run completed: peak=66k rps (40s spike), avg=49k, errors=0.8% (mostly 429 on /batch/analytics), p95=285ms. Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/jobs/hp-warm-501/logs
Noah Grant: Observed cache hit-rate 69% -> 92% after priming. 429s concentrated on the excluded batch endpoints. No 5xx.
Elena Park: Action items: (1) set autoscale params per Noah, (2) enable soft-throttle on batch/ingest, (3) tag metrics with "bringup:HarborPrime", (4) set 5% graceful diversion to quantized fallback. Assign @Noah Grant and @Samira (CSM).
Samira (CSM): Invite sent for the 10-min morning checks and enablement walkthrough. Posted post-run feedback form: https://forms.gle/harborprime-feedback
Elena Park: Thanks  reconvene 72h after go-live for post-mortem and renewal-readiness summary. :white_check_mark:
